mcp_tools.name: edge_platform_engineering
mcp_tools.title: Edge platform engineering
mcp_tools.description: Submits an edge-platform engineering record (platform fit and storage, deploys and versioning, security and Access, reliability, tunnels, quotas and DNS/TLS) and returns a deterministic EDGE_PLATFORM_SOUND / EDGE_PLATFORM_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed storage-backend consistency and Access-coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it builds and deploys nothing.

inputSchema.description: The edge-platform manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

components.description: Declared components: {name, storage_backend, storage_rationale_documented, requires_strong_consistency, is_admin_surface, access_protected}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Components: 1 component (db-component, d1 backend, rationale documented, strong consistency on d1 not kv, admin surface with Access protected); tunnels_present false so tunnel checks pass as not applicable.
